Name: Perfect Penny
Author: tvheroman
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][b][size=4][u]OVERVIEW[/u][/size][/b]
[/font]
This is my first mod. I originally made it in early 2020 for personal use but it's about time I share my idyllic (imo) version of Penny with you.
The first versions were awkwardly put together and bugged with the new (old) sleep sprite. Version 2.0 was updated to work with Stardew Valley versions 1.5+ and include the beach portraits and sprites.

After playing Stardew for a few hundred hours, Penny has grown to become my absolute favorite bachelorette. She's the most perfect girl this side of the Gem Sea, but her appearance needed some loosening up.


[size=4][i][font=Courier New] ﻿Penny is letting down her hair, literally, only putting it back up into her classic buns at the beach. She now displays her natural freckles 24/7. Although she has a tendency to be more reserved, she can't completely contain herself, metaphorically and clothing-wise; especially when she meets you.[/font][/i]
[/size]

I combined multiple mods linked below, and of course did hours of my own meticulous work in both adjusting these combinations as well as adding plenty of my own pixel-by-pixel changes.

[list]
[*]Profile-facing hair and freckles: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42013760]magimatica[/url]﻿ on [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/860]Red's Penny[/url] #860﻿[/i]
[*]Regular sprites as a base: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/36338135]imnotahick[/url]﻿ on [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1044]Long-Haired Penny[/url] #1044﻿[/i]
[*]Body shapes and clothing as a base: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45534127]LambSteak[/url]﻿ on [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6138]Larger-breasted Penny with improved hair (SFW)[/url]﻿ #6138[/i]
[/list]
Versions of the above mods were used prior to SV update 1.5. [b]Everything else or thereafter is my work[/b] based on ConcernedApe's artwork, including but not limited to:

[list]
[*]Regular and beach portraits' bathing suits
[*]Regular portrait forward-facing in entirety
[*]All beach sprites in entirety
[*]Hair changes and clothing tweaks to all sprites
[*]Et cetera tweaks to above mods used
[/list]
Please feel free to use/alter/share this mod on the Nexus. I only ask you credit me as I credit others.


[b][font=Times New Roman][size=3]TLDR[/size][/font][/b]; My first mod. Vanilla character changes include hair, freckles, and boobs made by the creators above and tweaked a lot by me. These changes show in portraits and sprites, logically.



[b][font=Times New Roman][size=4][u]INSTALLATION[/u][/size][/font][/b]

FIRST AND FOREMOST, if you intend to use this mod ESPECIALLY alongside any others, always make a backup. In the worst case scenario, your game breaks and you need to re-verify the files through Steam, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4tTMRLhN72U]demonstrated in this video[/url]﻿, making you start from scratch with no mods. This can be avoided by creating a backup folder with the original game files.

[list=1]
[*]Create a folder for your backup files
[*]Create two folders inside this backup: one named "portraits" and one named "characters"
[*]Download the mod file from the "Files" tab located above
[*][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]Find the game folder[/url], most likely located at "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley"
[*]Remove the "Penny.xnb" and "Penny_Beach.xnb" files from "Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits" and place them in your backup
[*]Remove the "Penny.xnb" and "Penny_Beach.xnb" files from "Stardew Valley\Content\Characters" and place them in your backup
[*]Unzip/extract my mod file that you downloaded
[*]Place my "Portraits" .xnb files where you removed the originals
[*]Place my "Characters" .xnb files where you removed the originals
[*]Close all windows and launch the game! Enjoy!
[/list]
To [b]UNINSTALL[/b], simply replace my mod's .xnb files in "Content\Portraits" and "Content\Characters" with the original game files you placed in your backup folder.
